## Key Workflows

| Workflow | Purpose | Services/Activities Used |
| --- | --- | --- |

## Architecture

Linear dispatcher: reads all pending invoices, iterates each within a Try/Catch,
branches on the amount limit, and posts approved invoices to the finance
application via a UI-automation sub-workflow.
